svg.title: Alerts
svg.desc: Left: one alert on what readers feel, homepage errors over 2 percent for 5 minutes. It pages the on call phone once, with a runbook, and the engineer fixes it. Right: alerts on causes like CPU, disk, and restarts flood the phone, every page gets acknowledged without reading, and the one real outage scrolls past with the rest.
svg.text: One symptom page gets a real look. A flood of cause alerts gets ignored.
